description: Agent-based, network-embedded simulation of mask-wearing behavior under social influence, information dynamics, and policy interventions. People interact via a small-world social network and co-location at abstract location types (home, work, public). Perceived risk evolves from an environment prevalence signal with feedback from aggregate mask use. Public health policy and media messaging influence attitudes, compliance, and behavior over time.

parameters.income_distribution: lognormal(mu=10.5, sigma=0.5) in USD per year

modules.name: EnvironmentSignal
modules.description: Updates the environment's prevalence signal with noise and feedback from mask adoption; updates mask supply availability.

update_rule.pseudocode:
prev = state.Environment.base_infection_prevalence
adopt = obs.adoption_rate_daily[t-1] if t>0 else initial_adoption_rate
// feedback reduces prevalence proportional to mask effectiveness and adoption
feedback = - prevalence_feedback_beta * adopt * DecisionAndBehavior.mask_effectiveness
noise = Normal(0, prevalence_process_noise_std)
state.Environment.observed_prevalence_signal = clip(prev + feedback + noise, 0, 1)
// supply replenishment and depletion by mask usage
used_today = obs.masked_count_daily[t-1] if t>0 else round(initial_adoption_rate * population_size)
state.Environment.mask_availability = clip(state.Environment.mask_availability + supply_replenishment_rate - used_today/(population_size * purchase_pack_size), 0, 1)
outputs.signal.prevalence = state.Environment.observed_prevalence_signal
outputs.signal.mask_availability = state.Environment.mask_availability
notes: Feedback strength is adjusted by prevalence_feedback_beta.
Mask effectiveness from DecisionAndBehavior is referenced; module reads it as a global parameter.
Supply is a simple scalar availability in [0,1].

modules.name: NetworkBuilder
modules.description: Constructs the static social network connecting Persons.

notes: Household edges can be added by connecting household members with higher weight if desired.

modules.name: PolicyBroadcast
modules.description: Sets or updates mask mandate policy, enforcement strength, and conducts information campaigns.

update_rule.pseudocode:
mandate = state.PHA.mandate_active
if !mandate and Bernoulli(mandate_probability_per_day * (signal.prevalence > 0.02 ? 2 : 1)):
    mandate = True
elif mandate and Bernoulli(lift_probability_per_day * (signal.prevalence < 0.01 ? 2 : 1)):
    mandate = False
state.PHA.mandate_active = mandate
state.PHA.enforcement_strength = enforcement_strength
state.PHA.campaign_intensity = information_campaign_intensity
// message frequency affects how often guidance impacts individuals; stored for Decision module
state.PHA.message_frequency = information_message_frequency_per_day
outputs.policy.mandate_active = mandate
outputs.policy.enforcement_strength = state.PHA.enforcement_strength
outputs.policy.campaign_intensity = state.PHA.campaign_intensity
notes: Mandate activation probability can depend on prevalence.
Information campaigns intensity is constant unless tuned.

modules.name: MediaBroadcast
modules.description: Broadcasts information and misinformation affecting attitudes and perceived risk.

update_rule.pseudocode:
misinfo_event = Bernoulli(misinformation_rate)
debunk_event = Bernoulli((1 - misinformation_rate) * 0.2)
if misinfo_event:
    targeted = sample_fraction_of_people(misinformation_reach)
    for i in targeted:
        delta = misinformation_effect_size_on_attitude * Person[i].misinformation_susceptibility
        Person[i].mask_attitude = clip(Person[i].mask_attitude - delta, -1, 1)
        Person[i].perceived_risk = clip(Person[i].perceived_risk - 0.1*delta, 0, 1)
if debunk_event:
    targeted = sample_fraction_of_people(min(0.5, targeted_campaign_fraction))
    for i in targeted:
        delta = debunking_effectiveness * Person[i].trust_in_authorities
        Person[i].mask_attitude = clip(Person[i].mask_attitude + 0.5*delta, -1, 1)
        Person[i].perceived_risk = clip(Person[i].perceived_risk + 0.2*delta, 0, 1)
outputs.events.misinformation = misinfo_event
outputs.events.debunking = debunk_event
notes: Attitude is on [-1,1]; positive is pro-mask.
Reach is fraction of population sampled uniformly; could be stratified by demographics if data available.

modules.name: MobilityAndContact
modules.description: Determines daily co-location, contacts by location type, observed mask usage, and enforcement events.

notes: Contact sampling can be implemented via indexed pools for home/work/public.
Enforcement increases compliance propensity modestly on each event.

modules.name: DecisionAndBehavior
modules.description: Updates perceived risk, attitude via social influence, decides mask use, handles compliance, fatigue, and mask purchasing.

notes: Perceived risk blends environment and social observation.
Attitudes updated via a bounded DeGroot model.
Sigmoid(x) = 1/(1+exp(-x)); parameters scale terms to reasonable ranges.
Purchases constrained by environment mask availability.

modules.name: AdoptionAggregator
modules.description: Aggregates daily observables and computes intermediate statistics used by metrics.

notes: Compliance is computed only when mandate is active; resulting NaNs should be ignored in time averages.
Group stratification can be extended to education or network degree as needed.

algorithms.RiskUpdate: Perceived risk combines prevalence, observed unmasked fraction, and campaign influence with weights.
algorithms.LogitDecision: P(wear) = sigmoid(w1*risk + w2*attitude + w3*mandate/enforcement - w4*fatigue - cost).
algorithms.Enforcement: If mandate active and unmasked in regulated contexts, enforcement occurs with probability proportional to enforcement_strength, raising compliance_propensity.
algorithms.SupplyUpdate: Mask availability increases by replenishment_rate and decreases with usage; clipped [0,1].
algorithms.EventImpact: Misinformation events reduce attitudes for exposed subpopulation proportionally to susceptibility.
